name: Nejimaki Kiriko
source: Kiriko falls in love with Futahishi Kiseki, a boy who works at the large mansion she lives in. They share a wonderful time together, but somehow their encounter triggers the world's end. Suddenly, Kiriko finds herself back in time, back to the moment Kiseki first visited the mansion. With the ability to rewind time on her side, will Kiriko be able to save both the world and her love?
translation: 桐子爱上了在她居住的大宅子里工作的男孩二菱轨迹。他们一起度过了美好的时光，但不知何故，他们的相遇引发了世界末日。突然，桐子发现自己回到了过去，回到了木石第一次造访宅邸的那一刻。拥有时光倒流能力的桐子能否拯救世界和她的爱情呢？
